Plans built for real families

Pick the level of support that fits your household. All plans include your weekly dinner menu and shopping list. Upgrade for more customization and flexibility.

For small households

Starter

$9 $12 / month

Billed $108/yr

Billed monthly

The essentials. A complete dinner plan and shopping list every week.

  • 5 dinners per week
  • Organized weekly shopping list
  • PDF download of the menu
  • Email delivery every Friday
  • Serves 2–4
